execution_method: Import the workflow, then execute its fixture-only identifier through the n8n CLI. The HTTP node is replaced with a Code node returning a synthetic response; original mapping nodes and connections are unchanged.

checks.behavior: Stops before CSV export with explicit no-passages error.

csv_inspection: Two additional executions append a diagnostic node after the unchanged CSV export node. The node reads the generated binary through getBinaryDataBuffer. Parsed CSV preserves commas, quotation marks, source links and coverage fields.
